tests.description: Reference: WRF 4.8 em_scm_xy COLD-SEASON single-column run, data/eqwefic/noahcold_scm, dumped by ctessum-claude/WRF branch earthsciml-instrumented-noahcold and replayed through the real64 (-fdefault-real-8) kernels/noah_driver at ESM_DT = 1e-6 s. tbnd, tavg and free are all evaluated by HRT on the INPUT column, before HSTEP advances anything, so they carry only the O(dt) dependence that reaches them through tsurf and through the sh2o SMFLX has already moved; 1e-6 s is therefore the right reference step, the same choice the soil-heat surface closure makes and for the same reason. The test supplies the replay's own frz_tsurf and frz_sh2o_hrt -- the liquid water HRT holds at the point it decides whether to evaluate the phase change, captured for EVERY layer whether SNKSRC is called or not, not the pre-SFLX value; the two differ at 193 of the 332 layer-calls because SMFLX has already moved the water by then. The TOTAL moisture is supplied the same way, as frz_sh2o_hrt + frz_sice, because HRT's smc has been advanced by SSTEP too -- taking smc from the dump's arguments while taking sh2o from inside HRT gives an ice content that is neither, which is what first made the evaluation guard and the equilibrium comparison disagree with WRF. tavg and free are asserted only at the layers where HRT's guard fired and WRF therefore formed them; the guard itself is asserted against the replay's frz_called at every layer, which is what makes the restriction a tested claim rather than a convenient omission. tbnd is asserted at layers 1-3 only: HRT calls TBND with tbot for the deepest layer through a separate call that the instrumentation does not publish, so layer 4's boundary temperature has no reference here. Step 1 of case A, snow accumulating onto initially bare frozen ground. Layer(s) [4] need the SECOND Newton iterate; the rest exit after the first. THE SINK IS NOW PINNED, which it was not when this component landed (FORTRAN_BUGS N97, since resolved). SNKSRC now publishes the RAW energy-driven xh2o, the sh2o it was formed from, the layer thickness and WHICH of its clamps fired, so tsnsr no longer has to be recovered from a difference that cancellation destroys. phase_active is asserted against the published clamp decision with ZERO tolerance and matches at every one of the 332 layer-calls; tsnsr and dsh2o_dt_phase are asserted against exact expressions in the published qtot and dz rather than against the differenced value, which at ESM_DT = 1e-6 s was off by up to 5.9e-3 relative. dstc_dt is asserted to be EXACTLY zero on every layer where the phase change is admitted -- the freezing plateau -- which holds independently of the heat capacity and is why this test can supply a placeholder hcpct.
